Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: And it was after the plague — God spoke to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, saying:
translations.2: 'Take up the count of the whole congregation of the sons of Israel, from twenty years of age and upward, by their fathers' houses, every one who goes forth in their armies.'
translations.3: And Moses and Eleazar the priest ordered their counting in the wilderness plain of Moab, by the Jordan of Jericho.
translations.4: From twenty years of age and upward — as God had commanded Moses and the sons of Israel, those going forth from the land of Egypt.
translations.5: And the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel — the clan of the Hanochites, and the clan of the Palluites;
translations.6: and the clan of the Hezronites, and the clan of the Carmites.
translations.7: And the count of the clans of Reuben was forty-three thousand, seven hundred and thirty.
translations.8: And the sons of Pallu: Eliab.
translations.9: And the sons of Eliab: Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram — they are Dathan and Abiram, the summoners of the congregation, who rallied against Moses and Aaron within the congregation of Korah; and that was before God.
translations.10: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them along with Korah, at the time of the death of the congregation — and fire consumed the two hundred and fifty men, and they became a sign.
translations.11: But as for the sons of Korah — the earth sank with them, and they did not die.
translations.12: The sons of Simeon by their clans: the clan of the Nemuelites, and the clan of the Jaminites, and the clan of the Jachinites;
translations.13: and the clan of the Zerahites, and the clan of the Shaulites.
translations.14: And the count of the clans of Simeon was twenty-two thousand and two hundred.
translations.15: The sons of Gad by their clans: the clan of the Zephonites, and the clan of the Haggites, and the clan of the Shunites;
translations.16: and the clan of the Oznites, and the clan of the Erites;
translations.17: and the clan of the Arodites, and the clan of the Arelites.
translations.18: And the count of the clans of Gad was forty thousand and five hundred.
translations.19: The sons of Judah — first Er and Onan; and they died in the land of Canaan.
translations.20: And the sons of Judah became, by their clans: the clan of the Shelanites, and the clan of the Parzites, and the clan of the Zerahites.
translations.21: And the sons of Perez: the clan of the Hezronites, and the clan of the Hamulites.
translations.22: And the count of the clans of Judah was seventy-six thousand and five hundred.
translations.23: The sons of Issachar by their clans: the clan of the Tolaites, and the clan of the Punites;
translations.24: and the clan of the Jashubites, and the clan of the Shimronites.
translations.25: And the count of the clans of Issachar was sixty-four thousand and three hundred.
translations.26: The sons of Zebulun by their clans: the clan of the Sardites, and the clan of the Elonites, and the clan of the Jahleelites.
translations.27: And the count of the clans of Zebulun was sixty thousand and five hundred.
translations.28: The sons of Joseph by their clans: Manasseh and Ephraim.
translations.29: The sons of Manasseh: the clan of the Machrites, and the clan of the Gileadites — from Gilead son of Machir.
translations.30: These are the sons of Gilead: the clan of the Iezerites, and the clan of the Helekites;
translations.31: and the clan of the Asrielites, and the clan of the Shechemites;
translations.32: and the clan of the Shemidaites, and the clan of the Hepherites.
translations.33: And Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons, only daughters; and their names were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
translations.34: And the count of the clans of Manasseh was fifty-two thousand and seven hundred.
translations.35: These are the sons of Ephraim by their clans: the clan of the Shutalhites, and the clan of the Becherites, and the clan of the Tahanites;
translations.36: and the clan of the Eranites, from Eran son of Shutelah.
translations.37: And the count of the clans of the sons of Ephraim was thirty-two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph by their clans.
translations.38: The sons of Benjamin by their clans: the clan of the Belaites, and the clan of the Ashbelites, and the clan of the Ahiramites;
translations.39: and the clan of the Shuphamites, and the clan of the Huphamites;
translations.40: and the clan of the Ardites, and the clan of the Naamites — from Bela.
translations.41: And the count of the clans of Benjamin was forty-five thousand and six hundred.
translations.42: And the sons of Dan by their clans: the clan of the Shuhamites, and what branched out from it.
translations.43: And their count was sixty-four thousand and four hundred.
translations.44: The sons of Asher by their clans: the clan of the Imnites, and the clan of the Ishvites, and the clan of the Beriites;
translations.45: the clan of the Heberites, and the clan of the Malchielites — from the clan of the Beriites.
translations.46: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
translations.47: And the count of the clans of Asher was fifty-three thousand and four hundred.
translations.48: The sons of Naphtali by their clans: the clan of the Jahzeelites, and the clan of the Gunites;
translations.49: and the clan of the Jezerites, and the clan of the Shillemites.
translations.50: And the count of the clans of Naphtali was forty-five thousand and four hundred.
translations.51: That, then, is the count of the sons of Israel: six hundred thousand and one thousand, seven hundred and thirty.
translations.52: Then God spoke to Moses, addressing him.
translations.53: 'To these it is required that the land be apportioned as an inheritance, by the count of their names.
translations.54: To the numerous you shall enlarge his inheritance, and to the few you shall diminish his inheritance — each tribe according to the measure of its number shall its inheritance be given.
translations.55: But by lots shall the land be apportioned, by the names of the tribes of their fathers.
translations.56: According to the measure of the lots shall their inheritance be apportioned, between the numerous and the few.'
translations.57: And these are the counts of Levi by their clans: the clan of the Gershonites, and the clan of the Kohathites, and the clan of the Merarites.
translations.58: And the rest of their clans: the clan of the Libnites, and the clan of the Hebronites, and the clan of the Mahlites, and the clan of the Mushites, and the clan of the Korahites — and Kohath begot Amram.
translations.59: And the name of the wife of Amram was Jochebed, daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt; and she bore to Amram: Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
translations.60: And there were born to Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
translations.61: And Nadab and Abihu died when the two of them offered strange fire before God.
translations.62: And their count was twenty-three thousand — every male from a month of age and upward; since they were not counted among the total of the sons of Israel, since no inheritance was given to them in their midst.
translations.63: These are the counts of Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the sons of Israel in the wilderness plain of Moab, by the Jordan of Jericho.
translations.64: And among these there was not a man from among those counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who had counted the sons of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai —
translations.65: for God had decreed upon them that they should die one by one in the wilderness; and not a man remained of them, save Caleb son of Jephunneh, and Joshua son of Nun.
